---
title: Create Loyalty Pass from Template
description: How to quickly launch a digital card using pre-made industry templates.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1372" height="758" />

1.

- Navigate to Templates.

- Filter by type and search or choose a template pass.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="575" height="440" />

2. Preview selected template and click **“Use Template”** to apply.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="530" height="390" />
